source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 857 passes the persisted interactedWith IDs into filtering. The current getNotifications still does so, and markAsInteractedWith deduplicates and saves that list. The wire field remains displayed_notifications while the implementation names the history for interaction. Do not treat these names as evidence of an impression counter. Preserve the exact wire snake_case and the local lowerCamelCase names instead of silently renaming serialized data.
title: Distinguish notification interaction history from visual display
